wt_note: Monthly Macro Watch
relationship: Ocean Data; from prots of LA, Long Beach and Oakland; West Coast port volumes, measured in twenty-foot equivalent units, are released monthly from the ports of Los Angeles, Long Beach and Oakland. Historically, these three ports account for roughly 85% of total West Coast ocean volumes and approximately 55% of total U.S. port volumes. Among the three ports, Los Angeles accounts for approximately 49% of total volumes, with Long Beach and Oakland accounting for approximately 36% and 15%, respectively. Imports typically account for roughly 65% of total volumes.
